headline: RE-AUTHORING WORKS: 0/8 -> 4/8 correct (+2 partial), and ZERO games still fixate on the HUD. Retracting the HUD-band rules + naming the mover's target + overriding the counter-framing flipped every game from 'fill/change the counter' to 'move the player to a target'. Correct on the 4 navigate/move-to-target games (sc25/tu93/bp35/r11l -- even the 3 where no mover was detected, because retracting the wrong rule was enough). Residual: it OVERCORRECTS the 2 non-navigate games (lf52 merge, ft09 CSP) into a navigate frame -- because the block asserts 'move player to target' even when NO mover was detected. Approaches the oracle's 7/8 but not yet there (the oracle named the specific per-game entity + mechanic).
next_step: Gate the 'move player to a target' assertion on mover-detected: when no mover is found, use a neutral 'arrange the game objects; the counters are not the goal' frame instead of imposing navigation. That should recover lf52/ft09 without losing the 4 navigate wins. Then wire reauthor_framing into the live E3AgentPolicy perception + the greedy-direct reflection, and add the execution/dynamics half.
